items.quote: In view of the volatility of Mn, compositions of two selected Mnrich alloys were measured using inductively coupled plasma/atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP).
After being mounted, ground and polished, equilibrated alloys were subjected to OM and SEM/EDX analyses.

A Mn-rich alloy was measured by using differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) again with the same heating and cooling rate as that applied to DTA measurement in order to ascertain the accurate reaction temperature on the invariant equilibrium.
Differential thermal analysis (DTA) was carried out by using a Netzsch 404C apparatus both on heating and on cooling with a rate of 5 K/min.
Phase identifications of annealed alloys were carried out by XRD using Cu K␣1 and K␣2 radiation with an intensity ratio of I1 /I2 = 2/1.
